notes: *Now when* is one rendering of the opening waw under rule 55's coordinator-plus-subordinator clause, headed on the coordinator; heading on *when* is the competing reading the corpus also records.
The object marker takes the *of* of *made an end of*, which exists only to attach the object to the English idiom (rule 16), while כִּלָּה heads on the light verb's complement *end* (rule 44).
The apodosis waw of וְהוֹצִיאַנִי is unrepresented, the ASV writing no second connective; and the doubled סָבִיב is rendered once by *round about*, taken on the first occurrence (rule 22).
